meta_note: All methods are exposed on the FinanceService gRPC server. Auth is enforced at the module level via RpcAuthGuard; the authenticated user is injected via @RpcUser(). Proto definitions live in packages/types/proto/finance/recurring.proto and packages/types/proto/finance/finance.proto.

conventions.auth: JWT injected via @RpcUser() decorator; guard applied at module level (RpcAuthGuard).

rpc_errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Missing or invalid JWT in gRPC metadata
rpc_errors.NOT_FOUND: Recurring item (or category) does not exist or does not belong to the user
rpc_errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Validation failed on the request payload

conventions.nextRunAt_rule: On create: if startDate >= today → nextRunAt = startDate; if startDate < today → next occurrence computed from today (no backfill). On frequency change or reactivation: recomputed from today forward.

createRecurring.description: Creates a new recurring income or expense item for the authenticated user. nextRunAt is computed automatically based on startDate vs. today. The scheduler service picks up active items and creates transactions on each run date.

input.name: string (required)
input.category_slug: string (required) — must belong to the user
input.end_date: string (optional) — ISO date; omit for indefinite recurrence

createRecurring.output: Recurinrg — full recurring item with category; transactions array is always empty on create

throws.NOT_FOUND: category_slug does not match any category owned by the user

getRecurrings.description: Returns all recurring items for the authenticated user. Supports server-side filtering by active status, type, and frequency, plus sorting. Active items always float to the top of results regardless of sort field.

input.is_active: bool (optional) — true: active items only; false: paused items only; omit: all items
input.sort_by: string (optional) — 'amount' (desc), 'name' (asc), or omit for nearest nextRunAt (asc). Active items always precede paused items.
input.type: repeated string (optional) — filter to 'INCOME', 'EXPENSE', or both
input.frequency: repeated string (optional) — filter to one or more frequency values

getRecurrings.output: GetRecurringsRes — { recurrings: Recurinrg[] }; transactions array is omitted for performance (always [])

getRecurring.description: Returns a single recurring item by ID, including its full transaction history (transactions ordered newest-first). Transactions are only included on this endpoint, not on getRecurrings.
getRecurring.output: Recurinrg — full item with category and transactions[] (descending date order)

throws.NOT_FOUND: Item does not exist or belongs to another user

updateRecurring.description: Updates an existing recurring item. All fields except id are optional; only provided fields are patched. If frequency changes, nextRunAt is recomputed from today so the scheduler picks up the new cadence immediately.

input.name: string (optional)
input.frequency: string (optional) — if changed, nextRunAt is recomputed from today
input.end_date: string (optional) — ISO date; send empty string to clear
input.description: string (optional) — send empty string to clear
input.merchant: string (optional) — send empty string to clear

updateRecurring.output: Recurinrg — updated item (transactions[] is empty on updates)

throws.NOT_FOUND: Item does not exist or belongs to another user

toggleRecurring.description: Toggles the isActive flag on a recurring item. Deactivating pauses the scheduler (no new transactions are created). Reactivating recomputes nextRunAt from today forward so the schedule resumes correctly without gaps.
toggleRecurring.output: Recurinrg — item with updated isActive and (if reactivated) updated nextRunAt

throws.NOT_FOUND: Item does not exist or belongs to another user

deleteRecurring.description: Permanently deletes a recurring item. Transactions that were already created by the scheduler are NOT deleted — they remain in the transaction ledger.

throws.NOT_FOUND: Item does not exist or belongs to another user

getRecurringsAggregate.description: Returns pre-computed aggregate metrics for the bills page widgets. Uses a single Prisma groupBy query (at most 24 rows: 6 frequencies × 2 types × 2 isActive states) — no row-level iteration on the server. Monthly amounts are normalised by a per-frequency multiplier (e.g. WEEKLY × 4.33). This endpoint is called by the API Gateway which Redis-caches the result for USER_CACHE_TTL (5 min) and invalidates on any mutation.

output.active_count: int32 — number of items where isActive = true
output.paused_count: int32 — number of items where isActive = false
output.monthly_expense: float — sum of all expense amounts normalised to a monthly equivalent
output.monthly_income: float — sum of all income amounts normalised to a monthly equivalent
